verdicts.observation: Several meanings drift from the source (angolwen.lua:55-65). (1) 'interested in the interactions of the elemental forces of the world' means how the elemental forces act on each other. The target '专注于元素之力是如何影响这个世界的' instead says how they affect the world. (2) 'are we not natural creatures that use it?' is a rhetorical question: we are natural creatures and we use magic, so magic is natural. The target '我们身为自然生物为何不能去尝试运用它？' turns this into 'why can't we try to use it', which loses the argument. (3) 'Plumes of fire' is rendered as '火焰烟柱'. 烟柱 means a column of smoke, so this is a mistranslation; it should be a pillar or spray of fire. (4) 'magic is still a powerful force that can be used for good or ill' is reduced to '一柄双刃剑'. That drops 'powerful force', and 双刃剑 suggests the magic hurts its own user, which is not the same as 'for good or ill'.

misc.lua:708: 'maybe these promises leave much to be desired' means the promises are unsatisfying or inadequate. The target '这些保证有些难以置信' says they are hard to believe, which is a meaning error. In the same sentence, 'if you wish me to be more concrete' is rendered as '如果你想要让我用语言描述的话' and the idea of being more concrete is lost. Also line 706: 'It is vast, more than you can imagine' is merged into '神奇而又美好…远远超出了任何人的想象'. That drops 'vast' and adds '美好', which the source does not say.
